title: DeterministicFinding
description: One finding emitted by a deterministic check in the Faraday Review plane (Phase 1). Findings carry no authorization semantics — classification into green/yellow/red/block is the Validator's alone. For secret_scan findings, `message` and every other field MUST NOT contain the matched secret value: only rule id, path, line, and rule class/entropy metadata are permitted (Correction 3).

rule_id.description: Stable identifier of the rule that fired (e.g. gitleaks rule id, protected-path pattern id).

check.description: Deterministic check that produced the finding (e.g. protected_paths, required_checks, secret_scan, pr_limits, freshness).

rule_class.description: Rule class or entropy descriptor. For secrets: the detector rule class, never the matched value.

message.description: Human-readable summary. MUST NOT contain secret values.
